profile_text.body:
Uber Technologies, Inc. is a publicly traded company (ticker UBER, CIK 0001543151) headquartered in San Francisco, California. Its website describes the Uber platform and apps as tools for earning, eating, commuting, getting a ride, and simplifying business travel. The company also states that it is introducing autonomous vehicles on Uber, describing a safety-driven approach that combines autonomous vehicles and drivers, and says it is partnering with industry leaders on that effort.

The company's litigation record shows 264 matters in California. No products, lawsuits, or MCP servers are currently tracked for it.
